annotation.title_clean: Remotely Piloted Aircraft (RPA) Operations, Design Specification, Maintenance and Training of Human Resources for Operations in Nigerian Airspace
annotation.title_en: Remotely Piloted Aircraft (RPA) Operations, Design Specification, Maintenance and Training of Human Resources for Operations in Nigerian Airspace
annotation.venue: Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority Advisory Circular NCAA-AC-AWS061
annotation.summary_en: Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority advisory circular (April 2023) guiding operation, design, certification, maintenance and pilot training for remotely piloted aircraft, with operator certificate (ROC) procedures, mandatory third-party insurance, incident reporting and enforcement. It requires RPA safety equivalent to manned aircraft.
key_provisions_or_claims: RPA operations must pose no greater risk than manned aircraft; non-certificated RPAs barred from controlled airspace.
RPA Operators Certificate required for all commercial and government civil operations, with ONSA security clearance and 2-year validity.
Design guidance: fail-safe flight termination/autonomous recovery, redundancy, data-link loss procedures.
Mandatory third-party insurance and accident/incident reporting within 72 hours.
Weight classes (micro, small, medium, large) set approval requirements; remote pilot training and examination required.
